messages.text:
¡Hola a todos!

Inés ya había mandado a la imprenta un letrero A4 para la barra y ahora el encargado quiere cambiar la hora de cierre del 24. El viernes lo aprobó con las ocho, hoy dice que a las seis. Cambiar el número no es nada, pero la imprenta ya tiene el PDF en la cola y me quiere cobrar como trabajo nuevo.

¿Alguien tiene un párrafo que meta en sus pedidos a imprenta sobre cambios después del visto bueno? Lo que sea que les haya funcionado.

Gracias, Mariana

Hola a todos:

A nosotros nos pasó con el teléfono de un volante media carta (21.5 x 14 cm), 500 piezas. La imprenta nos cobró $350 por sacar el archivo de la cola y meter el nuevo. Si todavía no lo habían metido, no cobraban nada.

Desde entonces lo dividimos así en el correo de aprobación:

Ya quedó: texto, teléfono y horarios.
Falta visto bueno: colores y prueba impresa.

Y le pido a la imprenta que me conteste por escrito que borró el archivo anterior. Suena exagerado hasta que estás en recepción con 500 volantes con el teléfono de otra sucursal.

Gracias, Paola

Paola Treviño
Coordinación de Marketing | Clínicas Diente de Sierra
paola.trevino@dientedesierra.example

Yo pondría la hora de cierre en el correo donde aprueban el texto. Si va solo en la cotización, a esas alturas nadie la encuentra.

Rena

Creo que la imprenta tiene algo así en la nota de la última cotización, la de los pizarrones. Voy a buscarla.

Gracias, Mariana

truth.summary: En la lista se habló de cómo evitar cobros de la imprenta cuando un cambio llega después de aprobar el arte, y nadie compartió el párrafo de ejemplo que pedía Mariana.
facts: Mariana puso como ejemplo un cambio de hora de cierre en un letrero A4 ya aprobado y enviado a la imprenta.
A Paola la imprenta le cobró $350 por cambiar un volante media carta que ya estaba en la cola.
Paola separa en el correo de aprobación lo que ya quedó de lo que falta por aprobar y pide a la imprenta confirmar por escrito que borró el archivo anterior.
Renata propuso poner la hora de cierre en el mismo correo donde se aprueba el texto.
Mariana dijo que buscaría una nota parecida en una cotización de la imprenta; no volvió a escribir.

messages.text:
Hi Luis!

I can get away from the theatre after six on Friday 27 November, but I can only travel Saturday morning. For the print sale, I found a car for €168 from the station in Lille with a €1,200 excess. There's a €72 option that brings it down to €100. The hire site only tells you this at the end, after it asks if you'd like to pay to cross a border, which we're not doing.

I can drive if that's what we all settle on. From Lille Flandres there is also a train to Roubaix, then about twelve minutes on foot. I was looking at cars because I thought Felix was bringing a box of books to sell. If I made that bit up then I might be solving a problem nobody has.

Clara x
I will carry books for much less than €1,200.

Hey all,

I'm sitting this one out from Sydney so I don't really get a vote, but I looked at the walk from Roubaix station on the map because I'd remembered it as a road with no pavement. Turns out I'd pinned the car park of a place with nearly the same name. The real one is fine, straight down from the station.

It's Tuesday lunchtime here, so the middle of your Monday night, sorry for the buzz.

Felix, are you actually selling books? I had the impression you were going to buy one thing and spend the rest of the day showing people where they'd put the staples.

Bec x

Dear Luis,

There is a small pile of paper on my desk which, I have just been told, is a veterinary surgery. Lotte has put a plush turtle in the middle of it and I have been asked to go round the long way so as not to disturb the patient.

No box of books. Bec is right, I would only buy one thing. The prints I was thinking of bringing are all under the surgery. Two are for Clara, and yours is the one with the grey blot at the foot, which is intentional in the sense that I didn't throw it away. I'll roll them and bring them in a tube.

So I say train. I did that walk once, years ago, in very bad shoes, and the only thing I remember is that it was flat. That is all you want from a walk carrying a tube.

I can meet you at Lille Flandres. I'll be the one with a tube that looks like it has something much better in it.

Love, Felix
train it is then. let's meet at Lille Flandres and go over together. Felix, the tube gets its own seat

Train for me too. I closed the rental page before I got to payment.

Clara x

truth.summary: The group decided to skip the €1,200 excess on a Lille hire car and take the train to Roubaix instead.
facts: The proposed car hire was €168 with a €1,200 excess.
Reducing the excess to €100 would add €72.
The alternative was a train via Lille Flandres for the print sale on 28 November.
No car was booked.

Hi Joana,

Can Clara borrow the tile museum card from reception when she stays with you? She's copied here. She was about to buy the annual membership for one visit. I remember you showing it to us but not whether it's one per room or one for the house.

Thanks,
Luis

Dear Mr. Luis,

Yes, Ms. Moreau can borrow it. There is one card for the house. Only the registered guest can use it and we ask her to return it to reception on the same day.

Best regards, Joana

Joana Ferreira
Blue Swallow Guesthouse | Bairro Alto, Lisbon

That settles it. I’ll borrow it on the Sunday and skip the annual membership. Thank you both.

Clara x
